queries.question: How do the recovered Tunnels of Doom consumers interpret the neutral per-floor candidate payload, and what did the existing held-out comparison establish?
queries.answer: The payload is a 17 by 26 active grid at VRAM >34B8..>36D1 with stride 32. GPL >A3B5 clears bit >10 and maps normalized >60..>6B to neutral classes; the >A5E1 consumer maps those values to cardinal connection masks. Existing authoring evidence agrees at 125 unique addresses. In the frozen held-out region, all 4 distinct raw/class/mask tuples were observed without contradiction; 11 of 16 coordinates were visited and five duplicate >6B/class-0/mask >00 coordinates remain notObserved. Exact game-level names and coordinate-specific meanings for unvisited cells remain unresolved.
